roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Expenses
roles.location: New York, New York, United States

bullets: Own the end-to-end strategy for enterprise expense management.
Unify documentation, policy, compliance, approvals, substantiation, audit, and ERP readiness.

Align specialized product teams around the complete expense lifecycle.
Use AI to automate routine work and route only judgment-heavy exceptions to people.

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Travel
roles.location: New York, New York, United States

bullets: Own the strategy and roadmap for the Brex Travel experience.
Build the journey across discovery, booking, trip organization, group travel, servicing, payments, and reconciliation.
Connect Travel with Brex Card and Expense Management so booking context flows through payment and accounting.
Turn partner technology, inventory, and servicing capabilities into a differentiated Brex product.
Own adoption, repeat usage, bookings, travel volume, conversion, and reliability.
